Name: Bruno
description: Bruno came to us as a stray and is now looking for his forever home. He's a young, energetic pup who loves to play and learn. He's good with other dogs with proper introductions and adores people. He needs an active family who will provide him with training and socialization.
care: Needs regular exercise and positive reinforcement training.

Name: Chesca
description: Chesca is a sweet senior looking for a calm and loving home to spend her golden years. She enjoys gentle walks and lots of cuddles. She's good with other calm dogs and loves people.
care: Prefers soft bedding and gentle exercise.

Name: Marshmallow
description: Marshmallow is a fluffy and adorable puppy who's full of potential. He's currently in training and needs a patient family who will continue to teach him. He loves to play and cuddle.
care: Needs puppy training, socialization, and regular grooming.

Name: Daisy
description: Daisy is a gentle and loving Golden Retriever who enjoys calm walks and being around her people. She's good with other dogs and loves attention.
care: Regular grooming to maintain her beautiful coat.

Name: Finn
description: Finn is a smart and energetic puppy who needs a home that can provide him with plenty of mental and physical stimulation. He's eager to learn and would excel in training.
care: Needs consistent training, exercise, and mental enrichment.

Name: Maya
description: Maya is an adventurous and loyal dog who loves being active. She's great for someone who enjoys outdoor activities. She forms strong bonds with her family.
care: Needs daily exercise and a high-protein diet.

Name: Yuki
description: Yuki is a smart and loyal dog who enjoys playing with his toys and spending time with his people. He's a quick learner and would enjoy activities like fetch and tug-of-war.
care: Regular exercise and mental stimulation are important for him.

Name: Presley
description: Presley is a sweet and gentle dog who enjoys a balance of playtime and relaxation. He needs a family who will help him maintain a healthy weight through portion control and exercise.
care: Requires portion-controlled meals and regular, gentle exercise.
